FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

New Mexico fishing licence

Anglers aged 12 or older need a state fishing licence outside exempt waters. Federal forest and BLM land can require a Habitat Stamp in addition to the access validation.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Residents and non-residents aged 12 or older.

Who doesn’t

  • Children aged 11 or younger.
  • State licences are not required on tribal reservations or private Class-A lakes; separate local rules apply.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
One-day fishingany1 day$12 USD
Five-day fishingany5 days$30 USD
Non-resident annualnon residentApril 1, 2026–March 31, 2027$90 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Habitat Management and Access Validation · $4 USD
    Required once per licence year from age 18, except with free licences.
  • Habitat Stamp · $10 USD
    Required from age 12 on US Forest Service and BLM lands, except with free licences.
  • Gila Trout Fishing Permit · $0 USD
    Required in the department's listed Gila trout waters.

Rules visitors should know

  • A Second Rod Validation is required for two rods from age 12 unless exempt.
  • Three rods are not allowed.

How to buy

Use the online sales portal, licence vendors, department offices, or 1-888-248-6866.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in New Mexico?

Anglers aged 12 or older need a state fishing licence outside exempt waters. Federal forest and BLM land can require a Habitat Stamp in addition to the access validation.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in New Mexico?

One-day fishing: $12 USD; Five-day fishing: $30 USD; Non-resident annual: $90 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in New Mexico?

Use the online sales portal, licence vendors, department offices, or 1-888-248-6866.
